findings.summary: Task 7 implementation is missing: process-pr-review-comments.ts still generates a version 1 single-comment manifest, processes tasks sequentially in a per-comment loop, and does not integrate comment batching or context selection.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite the execution loop to group unresolved comments into batches using commentBatcher, capture scoped snapshots, generate v2 manifest entries, call selectPrReviewContext, and invoke the batch overload of the runner.
